bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for a southeast Minnesota transportation management organization.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SOUTHEAST MINNESOTA TRANSPORTATION MANAGEMENT ORGANIZATION. +]

[+(a) $900,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to Southeast Service Cooperative for development and implementation of a transportation management organization that provides services in the counties of Dodge, Fillmore, Freeborn, Goodhue, Houston, Mower, Olmsted, Rice, Steele, Wabasha, and Winona. This appropriation is available for implementation costs, planning, and services related to transit and other forms of transportation. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029. +]

[+(b) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, the commissioner must not use any amount of this appropriation for administrative costs. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; appropriating money for a southeast Minnesota transportation management organization.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SOUTHEAST MINNESOTA TRANSPORTATION MANAGEMENT ORGANIZATION.

(a) $900,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of transportation for a grant to Southeast Service Cooperative for development and implementation of a transportation management organization that provides services in the counties of Dodge, Fillmore, Freeborn, Goodhue, Houston, Mower, Olmsted, Rice, Steele, Wabasha, and Winona. This appropriation is available for implementation costs, planning, and services related to transit and other forms of transportation. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.

(b) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, the commissioner must not use any amount of this appropriation for administrative costs.

This appropriation is available for implementation costs, planning, and services related to transit and other forms of transportation. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.
(b) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, the commissioner must not use any amount of this appropriation for administrative costs.
